newsitem.title: USA: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls.
newsitem.headline: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls.

text.p: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls as of 0810 CDT.
LIVE CATTLE - Steady to off 0.200 cent. Carryover technical fund selling seen but market looks oversold and cash cattle may trade firmer on tighter showlists.
FEEDER CATTLE - Steady to off 0.200 cent. Index up but higher corn futures seen weighing on market.
LEAN HOGS - Off 0.200 to up 0.100 cent. Weak product and hog markets but held technical level Monday and look oversold.
PORK BELLIES - Up 0.250 to off 0.300 cents. Cash stronger and lack of deliveries. February technically weak but needs to move premium to cash.
